verdict.rationale: An uptime SLA and a public status page are a fair question for a CPaaS video API vendor, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an uptime SLA, availability commitments, or a status page. Status Callbacks are per-room event webhooks, not a service status page, and Video Insights is a performance-analytics tool; both are adjacent features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, the vendor publishes an uptime SLA and a public status page I can check during an incident
